entities.summary: Equanimeous Tristan Imhotep John St. Brown is a German-American professional football wide receiver. He played college football for the Notre Dame Fighting Irish and was selected by the Green Bay Packers in the sixth round of the 2018 NFL draft. He has also played for the Chicago Bears and New Orleans Saints. He is the older brother of Detroit Lions receiver Amon-Ra St. Brown.
